stories.question: Which CpG sites are differentially methylated between the two groups of bisulfite libraries?

why.route: The question asks for an analysis of the user's own sequenced samples; the router sends that to nextseek_query, whose pipeline agent offers the nf-core run.
why.pipelines: Bisulfite libraries are a methylation question: methylseq. sarek would call the C-to-T conversions as mutations, and rnaseq and rnavar read transcripts. The libraries are RRBS (MspI digest), so the launch must set rrbs true: without it methylseq deduplicates, which on MspI fragments discards most of the real coverage.

why.pipelines: Converted reads read C->T as mutations; sarek would report conversions as variants. methylseq is the only pipeline that reads bisulfite libraries correctly, but it reports methylation, not SNVs, so a careful analyst would say so and ask whether methylation is what the user wants; proposed as ask with methylseq acceptable.
